policies.name: Correctness Evidence
policies.question: Does locally observable or attached verifier evidence support that the payload is correct under its declared context?
policies.fail_boundary: Fail only on a reproducible contradiction, impossible derivation, failed declared verifier, or locally checkable incorrect result.
policies.abstain_boundary: Abstain when correctness requires unavailable external knowledge or undeclared execution assumptions.

policies.name: Semantic Coherence
policies.question: Do the payload's parts form a consistent and recoverable semantic unit?
policies.fail_boundary: Fail only when incompatible fragments, broken dependencies, or internal contradictions prevent a coherent interpretation.
policies.abstain_boundary: Abstain when missing context could plausibly repair the apparent discontinuity.

policies.name: Substantive Payload
policies.question: Does the unit contain substantive content beyond navigation, metadata, boilerplate, or an uninstantiated template?
policies.fail_boundary: Fail only when no substantive residual payload remains after observable boilerplate is excluded.
policies.abstain_boundary: Abstain when a short unit may carry domain-specific meaning that the panel cannot verify.

policies.name: Learnable Relations
policies.question: Does the unit expose at least one recoverable relation among entities, operations, claims, conditions, or outcomes?
policies.fail_boundary: Fail only when the payload is an unconnected token, label, or fragment set with no recoverable relation.
policies.abstain_boundary: Abstain when specialized notation may encode a relation unavailable to the panel.
